title: Resident Evil 3
provenance: Reported by CarlosMunoz0 (highball-db#521, 2026-10-17), Apple M5, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.15, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r26, D3DMetal, recipes steam and vcrun2022, rated 4 of 5 after 50 minutes. The one complaint was having to set the environment's graphics mode to D3DMetal by hand. Not verified by the maintainer. richham2008 (highball-db#908, 2026-11-02), Apple M2, macOS 26.6.2, Highball 0.10.23, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal, rated 3 of 5 after 15 minutes: the default settings were too choppy and DLSS helped a lot.
notes: The 2020 remake. RE Engine, and Direct3D 12 since the game's 2022 update (Direct3D 11 is only on the dx11_non-rt beta branch), so D3DMetal is the mode and this page picks it. Played for 50 minutes on an M5 on the default engine. On M1 and M2, RE Engine games can need the Wine 11 engine with HB_TSSHIM_ATOMIC64=1, as the Onimusha demo does, untested for this one.
